metadata.title: Anthropic’s IPO Price Isn’t Outlandish. Here’s the Case for the Stock.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Anthropic’s IPO Price Isn’t So Outlandish. Here’s the Case for the Stock.
Anthropic’s bankers seem to have lowered their IPO expectations following recent turmoil in the tech sector. It’s a potential win for retail investors.
Not long ago, Wall Street was whispering about a $2 trillion valuation for Anthropic’s coming initial public offering. Now, after a series of artificial-intelligence-led selloffs, the company’s bankers have officially set a price range for the stock and, relatively speaking, it looks cheap.
